description: Preview design documents written in Markdown: mermaid sequence diagrams and flowcharts side by side with their linked step descriptions, a table of contents, GitHub alerts and task lists.
mdDesignDoc.openPreview.title: Open Design Doc Preview
mdDesignDoc.openPreviewToSide.title: Open Design Doc Preview to the Side
mdDesignDoc.exportHtml.title: Export Design Doc as HTML
mdDesignDoc.splitMinWidth.description: Minimum preview width (px) at which a sequence diagram or flowchart and its step descriptions are shown side by side. Horizontal flowcharts (LR / RL) are always shown above their step descriptions.
mdDesignDoc.syncEditor.description: Synchronize the preview with the editor cursor and scroll position, and jump to the source line on double-click in the preview.
mdDesignDoc.toc.description: Show a table of contents (headings h1-h3) that opens when hovering the right edge of the preview.
mdDesignDoc.diagramLook.description: Look of the mermaid diagrams in the preview and in exported HTML. A diagram can still choose its own with `config: look:` in its front matter.
mdDesignDoc.diagramLook.neo: mermaid's default look: rounder shapes, with shadows on flowchart nodes.
mdDesignDoc.diagramLook.classic: The flat look of earlier mermaid versions, without shadows.
mdDesignDoc.frontMatter.description: Show the YAML front matter at the top of the document as a table of its metadata (title, version, status...). When off, it is hidden.
mdDesignDoc.diagnostics.description: Report link warnings and arrows or headings without a link in the Problems panel for open Markdown files, even when no preview is open.
